text:
anika: heads up — after the Okta SAML claim change this morning, SCIM provisioning is failing for a bunch of customers. getting 500/403 from /scim/v2/Users. anyone else seeing?

lee: saw alerts, ops-bot posted group-sync failures. digging into logs now. :eyes: https://logs.redwood/internal?query=scim+500

ops-bot: alert: 47 group-sync errors in last 10m. sample error: `502 upstream_error`

sam: I dug in — SCIM secret decrypt is failing in the secrets service. KMSDecryptException: AccessDenied. snippet: ```ERROR kms.decrypt: AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:alias/redwood-scim-key```

maya: also noticed SAML assertion for affected users is missing the `roles` attribute. Okta app mapping was changed to send `Group` not `roles`. plus ACS URL mismatch: app shows `https://app.redwood.ai/saml/acs/` but our config expects `https://app.redwood.ai/saml/acs` (no trailing slash). small differences are breaking validation.

anika: ok — which is the primary blocker: role claim missing or KMS decrypt preventing fixes?

lee: both. because we can't decrypt the SCIM token we can't rotate or re-issue tokens. and without `roles` the SCIM->RBAC mapping fails and users land in default role. triage plan: 1) add temporary fallback mapping for `Group`->roles 2) restore KMS key policy so secrets service can decrypt 3) ask idp owner to revert mapping + fix ACS URL formatting

jess: @security-bot can you confirm if a KMS policy change happened? I see a key rotation event around 2415009000 in CloudTrail.

security-bot: Confirmed: KMS alias `alias/redwood-scim-key` was rotated and policy was tightened. The previous key policy allowed `service/secrets` principal to call `kms:Decrypt`; the new policy does not. Filing a policy rollback PR and notifying infra owners. :warning:

sam: temp mitigation applied — updated our SCIM RBAC mapper to accept `Group` claim and translate to roles for known group names. rolling change: `kubectl set env deployment/scim-mapper FALLBACK_GROUP=true`

anika: also adding a tolerance for trailing slash on the ACS URL check for the next 24h so we don't fail validation while idp is fixed. deploy link: https://deploys.redwood/1234

lee: after security restores KMS policy we should rotate the SCIM token immediately: steps: 1) revoke current token 2) create new token in Okta 3) encrypt with KMS and update secret 4) trigger full SCIM sync. I'll own coordination.

maya: adding runbook steps to the incident doc: check KMS key alias & policy, validate Okta claim mapping (roles vs Group), exact ACS + Audience values (watch trailing slash), rotate tokens after key changes. creating follow-up ticket INC-5437.

anika: good. if we see user-facing error spikes >5% ping pager and escalate to oncall. will update when security-bot PR merges. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
